_readme: The house style of the Uzbek quarterly housing review, distilled from four
published issues: the UzMRC market and mortgage reviews for 2025-Q2, Q3 and Q4,
and the Central Bank's 2025 annual housing market analysis.
This file carries STRUCTURE and GRAMMAR only. It deliberately carries no figure
from those reports: every example writes «X» where a number would stand and
«hudud» where a place would. A style exemplar that carried a real figure could
be copied into a report it does not belong to, and the writing step would then
fail its own numeric guard. Patterns are safe to imitate; other people's numbers
Edit this file to change how the report reads. `uzhousing/report/house_style.py`
loads it and puts it in front of the model on every run.

register.voice: A market analyst at a mortgage refinancing company writing for policy readers, bank managers and journalists. Confident about what the data show, careful about what causes them.
register.person: Impersonal. The report observes and records; it does not say 'we think'. 'kuzatildi', 'qayd etildi', 'ko'rsatmoqda'.
register.tense: The quarter is reported in the past ('pasaydi', 'qayd etildi'); a standing trend is reported in the continuous ('davom etmoqda', 'kuzatilmoqda').

section_order.title: ASOSIY TAHLILIY XULOSALAR
section_order.note: Numbered themes, each a bold lead-in plus two or three sentences. Added in the Q4 issue and worth keeping: a reader who stops here still leaves with the quarter.

market_section_shape: A regional table: the previous quarter's level, its change, this quarter's level, its change.
A Tashkent district table in the same shape.
Two to four commentary bullets beside the table, never a walk down its rows.
One 'Manba' callout stating the source, the scraping method, the listing counts behind a median and the quarter-end USD/UZS rate the som figures were priced at.
One 'Eslatma' line: asking prices may differ from transaction prices.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: What the quarter did, across places, in one sentence.
paragraph_grammar.pattern: «davr» O'zbekiston «segment» bozorida hududlar kesimida asosan narxlarning «yo'nalish»i kuzatildi.
paragraph_grammar.notes: Always names the period, the segment and the cross-section. 'asosan' carries the fact that it was not universal.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: Tie this quarter to the last one. The reference never reports a quarter in isolation.
paragraph_grammar.pattern: Joriy yilning «oldingi chorak»ida «teskari yo'nalish» qayd etilgan hududlarda «chorak»ka kelib biroz «yo'nalish» yuz berdi.
alternatives: «hudud»da ketma-ket ikkinchi chorakda ham narxlar «yo'nalish»i kuzatildi.
poytaxtda yil boshidan buyon davom etayotgan tushish sur'ati «chorak»ka kelib biroz sekinlashdi.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: Who carried the move. Named places, each with its own figure.
paragraph_grammar.pattern: Eng yuqori narx «yo'nalish»i «hudud» (X foiz), «hudud» (X foiz) va «hudud» (X foiz) hududlarida qayd etildi.
paragraph_grammar.notes: Two to four names, never more. The figure sits in brackets beside the name it belongs to.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: What moved against the tide. A quarter is never all one way, and saying so is what makes the main finding credible.
paragraph_grammar.pattern: Bozordagi narxlar «yo'nalish»i fonida, ayrim hududlarda, aksincha, narxlarning biroz «teskari yo'nalish»i ham kuzatildi. Eng yuqori «teskari yo'nalish» «hudud» (X foiz) va «hudud» (X foiz) viloyatlarida qayd etildi.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: Where everything else sat, so the reader can size the move without reading the table.
paragraph_grammar.pattern: Qolgan hududlarda esa o'zgarish sur'atlari X-X foiz oralig'ida bo'ldi.
alternatives: Boshqa tumanlarda esa pasayish sur'ati X foizdan pastroq bo'ldi.
Qolgan tumanlarda esa ijara narxlari o'sishi X-X foiz atrofida bo'ldi.
paragraph_grammar.notes: This is the sentence that replaces any statement about the middle of a column of changes. A range a reader can picture; never 'the median of the regional changes'.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: Where the market is dear and where it is cheap, in levels rather than changes.
paragraph_grammar.pattern: Narxlar bo'yicha eng arzon «joy» («X million so'm»), eng qimmat «joy»lar «joy» («X million so'm») va «joy» («X million so'm») bo'lib qolmoqda.

paragraph_grammar.purpose: Why. Always a separate paragraph, always hedged, always naming a channel.
paragraph_grammar.notes: See causal_channels. The explanation paragraph comes after the description, never instead of it.

causal_channels.mechanism: A market that rose steeply in 2020-2023 giving some of it back; prices returning to what incomes support.
causal_channels.phrasing: «hudud»da kuzatilayotgan narxlarning qisman pasayishini «avvalgi davr»da qayd etilgan yuqori o'sish sur'atlarining «tabiiy korreksiya»si sifatida izohlash mumkin.
causal_channels.needs: A documented earlier run-up in the same series or segment. Take the years of that run-up from the evidence; never write them from the corpus.

causal_channels.mechanism: Listings are posted in US dollars. When the som strengthens against the dollar, the som price falls even though the dollar price did not move. Arithmetic, not a hypothesis.
causal_channels.phrasing: Yurtimizda uy-joy bozoridagi e'lonlar odatda AQSH dollarida joylashtiriladi. «davr» yakuniga ko'ra milliy valyuta AQSH dollariga nisbatan X foizga mustahkamlandi. Bu jarayon narxlarning dollar qiymatida oshishiga qaramasdan, milliy valyutada biroz arzonlashiga o'z ta'sirini ko'rsatgan.
causal_channels.needs: The quarter-end official rate at both ends of the comparison.

causal_channels.mechanism: Large-scale construction in the capital and large cities fills the market with new housing; the primary-market surplus passes into the secondary market and steadies prices.
causal_channels.phrasing: So'nggi yillarda, xususan, poytaxt va yirik shaharlarda amalga oshirilgan keng ko'lamli qurilish ishlari natijasida bozor yangi uy-joylar bilan to'yinishda davom etmoqda. Bu o'z navbatida ikkilamchi bozorga ham ta'sir ko'rsatib, taklif hajmini oshirmoqda.
causal_channels.needs: Completions or construction-volume figures for the period.

causal_channels.mechanism: Growth concentrated in the regions whose prices are lowest, narrowing the gap with the capital. Testable directly: are the rising places the cheap ones?
causal_channels.phrasing: Bu o'sish Respublikaning yirik markazlariga qaraganda uy-joy narxlari past bo'lgan hududlarda kuzatilmoqda, bu esa hududlar bilan narx tafovutining qisqarayotganidan dalolat beradi.
causal_channels.needs: The report's own cross-section: the rank correlation between a region's price level and its change.

causal_channels.mechanism: Demand brought forward in earlier quarters leaving a thinner pipeline, so prices correct.
causal_channels.phrasing: «hudud»dagi pasayish talabning vaqtinchalik to'yingani natijasidagi korreksiya bo'lishi mumkin.
causal_channels.needs: A run of strong quarters immediately before the fall.

causal_channels.mechanism: Subsidised mortgage on the primary market moves demand toward new build and away from the secondary market; the volume disbursed sets how hard it pushes.
causal_channels.phrasing: Birlamchi bozordagi ipoteka hajmining sezilarli o'sishini imtiyozli kredit shartlari va xaridorlarning yangi, zamonaviy uy-joyga bo'lgan talabi ortib borayotgani bilan izohlash mumkin.
causal_channels.needs: Disbursement volumes or a decree changing the terms.

causal_channels.mechanism: Wages and incomes rising faster than house prices, so the same dwelling costs fewer months of pay.
causal_channels.phrasing: O'rtacha oylik ish haqi va aholi jon boshiga daromadlarning uy-joy narxlariga nisbatan yuqoriroq o'sishi aholining xarid qobiliyatiga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatgan.
causal_channels.needs: Wage or income growth for the period, against the price change.

causal_channels.mechanism: Annual population growth and new family formation running well ahead of completions, keeping a floor under demand.
causal_channels.phrasing: Yillik demografik o'sish va yangi tashkil etilayotgan oilalar soni qurib bitkazilgan xonadonlar sonidan yuqori bo'lib qolmoqda, bu esa uy-joyga bo'lgan real talabni ushlab turmoqda.
causal_channels.needs: Population or marriage figures against completions.

causal_channels.mechanism: Policy rate, mortgage rates, LTV and down-payment requirements setting how much house a given income can buy.
causal_channels.phrasing: Ipoteka kreditlari bo'yicha o'rtacha tortilgan foiz stavkalarining pasayishi resurs xarajatlari kamayishi yoki banklararo raqobat kuchayishi bilan izohlanishi mumkin.
causal_channels.needs: Rate or regulatory figures for the period.

causal_channels.mechanism: Rents move on their own calendar: term times, seasonal labour migration and tourism. Evidence about sale prices is not evidence about rents.
causal_channels.phrasing: Ijara narxlarining chorakma-chorak harakati o'quv yili va mavsumiy migratsiya bilan bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin; bu omil sotuv narxlariga bir xil ta'sir qilmaydi.
causal_channels.needs: The quarter's position in the academic or agricultural year.

hedges._note: How the reference marks the strength of a claim. The grammar is the flag: a reader can tell a measured fact from an interpretation by the verb alone. Never state a cause with a bare 'chunki'.

thesis_sentences._note: The Central Bank analysis opens each analytical block with a bold claim sentence, then spends the block evidencing it. A strong device: the reader gets the finding before the arithmetic.
examples: Uy-joy taklifining sezilarli o'sishi aholining tanlov imkoniyatlarini oshirgan.
Aholi xarid qobiliyatining oshishi fonida uy-joy sotib olish imkoniyatlari yaxshilangan.
Demografik o'sish tufayli uy-joyga bo'lgan talab dinamikasi barqaror oshish trendida davom etmoqda.

forbidden: Describing the shape of the table instead of the market: the middle of a column of changes names no place and no price.
A cause asserted with no channel between the force and the price.
A hypothesis written in the grammar of a documented fact.
Walking down the rows of a table in prose when the table is printed beside it.
Carrying a figure from a published report into a report built on different data.
